claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Cilnidipine is a dihydropyridine L-/N-type calcium channel blocker that at 2.5 uM is expected to be largely inactive as a cytotoxic agent, since its pharmacological actions (vasodilation, antiproteinuric effects) require channel blockade at sub-micromolar concentrations and do not translate into cancer cell killing.
